articles.title: 'Can I sell my house to my daughter for a reduced fee to avoid inheritance tax?'
articles.summary: Every week, we help readers with their consumer issue or personal finance dilemma in our Money Problem series. You can send yours to moneyblog@sky.uk. Today, we answer this question...

articles.title: Tesco 'drivers' mock Christmas ad for containing 'sackable offence'
articles.summary: Tesco's Christmas advert has been called out online for containing a "sackable offence".

articles.title: Job adverts must include salaries in 'clampdown' on recruiters
articles.summary: Job adverts must display a salary under plans for new transparency laws.

articles.title: Anthropic seeks $1.4trn valuation amid worry over AI investment
articles.summary: AI chatbot maker Anthropic is seeking a stock market valuation of up to $1.4trn (£1trn).

articles.title: Poundland owner releases £10m to retailer hours before MP grilling
articles.summary: Poundland's owner has released millions of pounds of funding to pay the discount retailer's suppliers - a breakthrough in talks about saving the company and its 10,500 staff.

articles.title: Fintech unicorn Zilch lands £165m debt boost as listing beckons
articles.summary: Zilch, the consumer payments app which has become one of Britain's most valuable fintechs, has secured a further £165m in borrowing firepower ahead of a prospective London flotation.

articles.title: Medicinal cannabis producer Grow Group weeds out new funding
articles.summary: A medicinal cannabis producer which distributes products in the UK and two other countries has struck a multimillion-pound refinancing deal after deciding against an outright sale.

articles.title: FBI investigating Nvidia CEO over affair with alleged Chinese spy
articles.summary: Donald Trump has said the FBI is looking into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy - but insisted he is a "very honourable man".

articles.title: Retail sector charity refuses to back Poundland owner's boss
articles.summary: Britain's leading retail charity has refused to give its public backing to the executive at the centre of the Poundland insolvency crisis amid intense political scrutiny of the US investment firm's conduct.

articles.title: Steel tycoon Gupta secures deal to keep grip on prized InfraBuild asset
articles.summary: The steel tycoon Sanjeev Gupta has struck an eleventh-hour deal to keep control of a prized Australian asset after a long-running legal tussle.
